result: Parse gap CONFIRMED on v0.78.0 exactly as reported: Notion Thief and Plagiarize both carry replacement execute.effect.type=Unimplemented on the 'skips that draw' half, with the 'you draw a card' half parsed as Draw{1}->Controller; Hullbreacher's single-action substitute parses fully to Token. In-engine, Notion Thief's replacement still resolves per Oracle (P1's 2 Divination draws skipped, P0 drew 2; A4A/A5A passed) - the Unimplemented node is latent for the static ability. Plagiarize could not be driven to its replacement: the engine never offered the 'target player' choice in two independent runs (CastSpell accepted with targets:[], spell resolved to graveyard, no replacement established; parse shows replacement valid_player=None) - a distinct target-binding gap, recorded as not-run for the B outcome assertions.
limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
8x key-card deck density is a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games); exercised behavior is the shipped card text.
Magus of the Chains shares the same Oracle text and parse class but was not driven (same-class coverage via Notion Thief/Plagiarize).
Plagiarize's missing target prompt is a distinct observation from the reported compound-substitute gap; it may warrant its own issue.
Not tested on the original 2026-07-12 build; verdict is scoped to v0.78.0, not a fix claim.
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
